items.abstract: <jats:p>Surface electromyography (sEMG) signals acquired with low-cost sensors tend to exhibit variable degradation that can compromise the reliability of myoelectric control systems outside controlled conditions. This work presents an adaptive processing pipeline for sEMG signals composed of three chained stages: a motor-intent classifier based on dilated temporal convolutional networks, whose function is to determine whether a signal window contains muscle activity associated with a voluntary gesture; a dual-output quality assessor that estimates a continuous score and a binary acceptability label, aimed at deciding whether the signal can be used directly or requires intervention; and a convolutional autoencoder that recovers the morphology of degraded windows before they are used in prosthetic control. The decision policy for reconstruction operates on two independent thresholds and classifies each window into one of three states: signal discard, direct acceptance, or active restoration. The models within the proposed architecture are trained on the public NinaPro DB1, DB3, and DB10 datasets and validated without recalibration on signals recorded from two participants with transradial amputation over three to four weekly sessions. The results show that the pipeline correctly handles signal profiles with opposing characteristics. Inference latency remained below 5 ms at the 50th percentile across all scenarios, consistent with real-time operation. All inference was executed on a host computer; a prototype using an Arduino UNO R4 WiFi as a peripheral interface was built to display the pipeline’s decisions on physical hardware and to confirm that the serial-communication link does not introduce additional latency, not to perform on-board inference. A downstream evaluation further showed that, while restoration improved signal-level fidelity metrics, it did not translate into improved motor-intent classification accuracy relative to using the degraded signal directly, a limitation discussed explicitly in this work.</jats:p>
title: Gestural Intent Detection and Adaptive Restoration of Degraded sEMG Signals Using Temporal Convolutional Networks and an Autoencoder

<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>W.E.B. Du Bois described the emancipation of four million enslaved people during the Civil War as the “most dramatic episode in American history.” Of course, as Du Bois himself understood, Emancipation was anything but episodic. It was a long, contested process that transformed the national economy and the American state. This article examines the federal commission charged with managing the process of emancipation—the American Freedmen’s Inquiry Commission (AFIC). Drawing on extensive archival research, this article advances an analysis of the AFIC’s activities with a focus on the Commissioners’ racial ideology, economic policy, and observations on wartime emancipation. This article shows how the AFIC advanced a vision of a post-Emancipation federal state which used labor and land regulation to reshape the political economy of the South. At the same time, the AFIC rejected or otherwise marginalized alternative visions of emancipation—from the racial domination of white planters to the liberatory hopes of freedpeople.</jats:p>
title: Architects of Managed Emancipation: The American Freedmen’s Inquiry Commission and the Multiple Visions of the Post-Emancipation American State

items.abstract: <jats:p>Background: Communication skills are an essential component of academic adaptation, social interaction, and the educational performance of university students. Assessing these skills upon entry allows for the identification of strengths and needs to guide timely educational actions. Objective: To identify the self-perceived level of communication skills in first-year university students, considering gender and academic major, based on the eight factors of the HABICOM questionnaire. Methodology: A quantitative, exploratory-descriptive, non-experimental, and cross-sectional study was conducted. A total of 192 responses from students in Nursing, Communication, Marketing, and Software Engineering at the University of Colima were analyzed. The personal self-perception dimension of the HABICOM questionnaire was applied, and descriptive analyses were performed using quartiles and percentage distributions. Results: Empathy presented the highest scores across the entire group of participants and all four majors. Emotional expression and information transmission showed the primary margins for improvement. Regarding gender, similar descriptive patterns were observed with variations in specific factors, although the study did not establish inferential differences. Conclusion: The results provide an initial diagnosis to guide transversal training strategies aimed at strengthening communication skills in incoming students.</jats:p>
title: Habilidades comunicativas en estudiantes de primer ingreso universitario: análisis descriptivo por género y carrera
Communication skills in first-year university students: a descriptive analysis by gender and degree program

                  <jats:p>Gewichtsverlust und Mangelernährung sind bei Parkinson häufig und multifaktoriell bedingt. Gleichzeitig rücken GLP-1-Rezeptor-Agonisten als potenziell krankheitsmodifizierende Therapie in den Fokus – trotz ihrer appetithemmenden und gewichtsreduzierenden Wirkung. Der Beitrag beleuchtet die Ursachen des Gewichtsverlusts, therapeutische Strategien und den aktuellen Stand der Evidenz der Behandlung mit GLP-1-Agonisten – einschließlich ihrer Chancen und möglichen Risiken.</jats:p>
title: Appetitzügler bei Parkinson? Zwischen Mangelernährung und GLP1-Agonisten

items.abstract: <jats:p>Several molecules have been investigated for their potential to improve muscle health in models of muscle damage simulating sarcopenia, injury, or aging. Some small molecules induced beneficial effects on skeletal muscle by stimulating the apelin receptor (APLNR). This receptor has emerged as a promising pharmacological target for modulating muscle homeostasis. Using an in silico approach, we recently identified 11β-hydroxypregnenolone (11β-OHP5) as a potential skeletal muscle (SKM) modulator. We hypothesized that 11β-OHP5 interacts with and activates APLNR. This study employed several research approaches: (1) in silico molecular docking and molecular dynamics to explore the feasibility of 11β-OHP5 interacting with APLNR; (2) in vitro activation analysis to APLNR; (3) in vitro analysis C2C12 myoblast differentiation; (4) analysis of the molecule’s presence in mouse skeletal muscle and its differential presence between young and older mice. The results show that 11β-OHP5, acting through APLNR, positively affects myoblast differentiation and may participate in the exercise-induced benefits in aging mice. We show that 11β-OHP5 interacts with APLNR, induces myogenic responses, is found in SKM; its concentration decreases with age, and exercise restores it. More work is necessary to understand the physiology of this possible endogenous molecule.</jats:p>
title: Binding of a Novel 11β-Hydroxysteroid to the Apelin Receptor (APLNR) and Its Possible Role in Regulating Skeletal Muscle Health in Mice

items.abstract: <jats:p>El presente ensayo científico analiza la gestión directiva en instituciones educativas durante tiempos de crisis, integrando la variable del estrés organizacional y su impacto en la praxis pedagógica. A partir de la situación generada por la pandemia COVID-19 y su evolución posterior (2020-2025), se reflexiona sobre los desafíos que enfrentan los directivos para mantener la continuidad académica y gestionar la cadena de suministros educativos. Mediante una revisión documental de carácter cualitativo, se proponen cinco tendencias pedagógicas para reorientar la gerencia escolar: (a) estudiante como foco central del proceso formativo, (b) alianzas con docentes y comunidad, (c) reinvención de la cultura escolar, (d) integración tecnológica como mediador pedagógico y (e) sostenibilidad educativa. Se concluye que la pandemia, lejos de constituir exclusivamente un evento disruptivo, aceleró la transformación pedagógica al incorporar la hibridez, las competencias digitales docentes y el bienestar socioemocional como ejes del proceso formativo, convirtiendo el estrés directivo en catalizador de la innovación educativa y consolidando instituciones más resilientes.</jats:p>
title: TENDENCIAS DE LA GERENCIA LOGÍSTICA EN TIEMPOS DE CRISIS: UNA MIRADA DESDE LA PEDAGOGÍA

items.abstract: <jats:p>This article examines the influence of the Peruvian Arbitration Act (Legislative Decree 1071) on Paraguay’s new Arbitration Law (Law 7561), enacted in December 2025. Adopting a comparative law approach, it identifies the provisions of the Paraguayan legislation that, while primarily structured upon the UNCITRAL Model Law, incorporate principles and legal institutions previously developed by the Peruvian legislator. The study focuses on arbitral autonomy and the limitation of judicial intervention, the extension of arbitration agreements to non-signatories, the regime governing interim measures, the powers of arbitral tribunals following the issuance of the award, and the rules governing judicial review and the effects of annulment. It argues that the influence of the Peruvian Arbitration Act extends beyond the adoption of isolated legal solutions and reaches the very conception of arbitration embodied in the Paraguayan reform. The article concludes that the Peruvian Arbitration Act has become a regional legislative reference, contributing to the harmonization and consolidation of a modern, efficient, and arbitration-friendly legal framework throughout Latin America.</jats:p>
title: La influencia de la Ley peruana de Arbitraje en la nueva Ley paraguaya de Arbitraje
<i>The Influence of the Peruvian Arbitration Act on Paraguay’s New Arbitration Law</i>

<jats:p>INTRODUCCIÓN. Considerando la amplia evidencia sobre el impacto positivo de las prácticas restaurativas (PR) en diferentes etapas educativas, este trabajo analiza su implementación en estudiantes universitarios y evalúa sus efectos.
MÉTODO. La muestra estuvo formada por 50 estudiantes universitarios de la Facultad de Educación. Se administraron cuestionarios para evaluar el conocimiento autopercibido sobre PR antes y después de cursar una asignatura semestral de grado o de máster, la probabilidad de aplicación de las PR en contextos personales y profesionales, la participación individual y grupal, la dedicación y otros efectos.
RESULTADOS. La prueba t mostró un aumento significativo del conocimiento sobre PR entre el inicio y el final del curso (t(49) = 13,10; p < 0,001; d = 1,85). El 60 % reportó una alta probabilidad de aplicar las PR en el ámbito profesional o personal. Las medias de los efectos percibidos (escala 1-5) oscilaron entre 4,03 (DT = 0,58) para la dedicación y 4,78 (DT = 0,69) para la participación grupal.
DISCUSIÓN. Los resultados sugieren que las PR en estudios universitarios generan efectos comparables a los observados en otros contextos educativos, es decir, más dedicación, mayor participación y más motivación, si bien se requieren más investigaciones.</jats:p>
title: Implementación de prácticas restaurativas en estudios universitarios: Efectos de una experiencia formativa

<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>In 2021, psychological violence was the most prevalent form of intimate partner violence (IPV) suffered by women in Mexico. The consequences of psychological IPV can include low self-esteem, depression, and even potential suicide. It is, therefore, crucial to identify the most relevant risk and protective factors of psychological IPV against women in Mexico. To this end, we adopt an ecological approach and analyze the role of a wide range of factors across four interrelated levels: Individual, relationship, community, and societal. We construct a multidimensional data set with 61,205 observations and 59 variables by integrating nationally representative data from the 2021 Mexican Survey on the Dynamics of Household Relationships with nine additional sources. For model estimation and factor selection, we combine model-based boosting with stability selection. Our findings reveal that women who were exposed to violence in childhood and whose partners were exposed to violence in childhood face a heightened risk of psychological IPV. These findings highlight the critical yet often overlooked role of childhood violence exposure for psychological IPV risk. Additionally, we confirm the role of three protective factors previously identified by Torres Munguía and Martínez-Zarzoso [1] using 2016 data, now validated with 2021 data: women who had their first sex later in life and under consent, who have autonomy in decision-making regarding their professional life and use of economic resources, and who live in a household where housework is done only by male members face a lower risk of suffering psychological IPV.</jats:p>
title: Mexico 2021: psychological intimate partner violence against women and the role of childhood violence exposure—a machine learning approach

items.abstract: <jats:p>El proyecto FENIX  4.0 ha sido distinguido con los Premios Europeos de Patrimonio 2026, uno de los máximos reconocimientos europeos en el ámbito del patrimonio cultural. El jurado ha valorado el desarrollo de unas metodologías esenciales en Europa que son capaces de integrar tecnologías digitales avanzadas con la formación práctica de profesionales y la implicación de la sociedad logrando reforzar la protección de bienes patrimoniales frente a incendios, inundaciones, terremotos y otros desastres naturales o de origen antrópico. El galardón consolida una línea de investigación iniciada hace más de una década y sitúa a España como referente europeo en la gestión del riesgo aplicada al patrimonio.</jats:p>
title: Europa Nostra 2026 premia el proyecto FENIX por impulsar la conservación preventiva y la respuesta ante emergencias

<jats:p>La anhidrosis idiopática generalizada adquirida (AIGA) es un trastorno infrecuente caracterizado por la incapacidad de sudar en ausencia de causas dermatológicas, neurológicas o metabólicas identificables. Se presenta el caso de una paciente de 23 años, con inicio de síntomas a los 8 años, quien desarrolló anhidrosis generalizada progresiva asociada a intolerancia al calor, prurito y lesiones cutáneas eritematosas exacerbadas por temperaturas elevadas. Al examen físico se evidenciaron máculas, pápulas y placas eritemato-violáceas en tronco y regiones axilares.
El test de Minor fue negativo, confirmando ausencia de sudoración. El reconocimiento oportuno es fundamental para prevenir complicaciones como hipertermia y golpe de calor. Este caso resalta la importancia de la correlación clínico-patológica en el diagnóstico de AIGA y contribuye a ampliar la evidencia sobre esta entidad.</jats:p>
title: Anhidrosis idiopática generalizada adquirida

items.abstract: <jats:p>Understanding turtle reproduction is crucial for gaining insights into its life history, particularly of endangered species as the Atrato River Slider, Trachemys medemi, for which this aspect is unknown. We estimated the timing of mating, spermatogenesis, vitellogenesis, nesting, and the quiescence of T. medemi in relation to serum sexual hormone levels, the local precipitation and temperature, and field observations. We captured 29 wild adult individuals between January 2022 and February 2023, including 25 unique females with 1 recapture (5 were gravid and 20 nongravid) and 4 unique males. We estimated that mating and nesting occur from December to March during the dry season when river beaches are available. During this time, gravid females (n = 5) had higher estradiol and progesterone, nongravid females had generally higher testosterone, and males exhibited basal hormones. The quiescent period was difficult to assess because of lack of hormonal data from April to July, and from September to November, but we infer that in females it occurs during the wet season when hormones were low (August), and in males from February or March when testosterone was basal to some time before August when testosterone increased 5.7×, suggesting the beginning of the spermiogenesis period in males. In conclusion, T. medemi follows an annual reproductive cycle with a prenuptial pattern and a single nesting season.</jats:p>
title: An Approximation of the Reproductive Cycle of the Atrato River Slider, Trachemys medemi

items.abstract: <jats:p>El uso de redes sociales constituye una práctica cotidiana durante la adolescencia y la juventud, pero su relación con la salud mental no puede explicarse únicamente por la cantidad de tiempo conectado. El objetivo de esta revisión de revisiones fue analizar la evidencia publicada entre 2020 y 2026 sobre la asociación entre el uso de redes sociales y los principales indicadores de salud mental en jóvenes, con énfasis en depresión, ansiedad, malestar psicológico, sueño, imagen corporal, ciberacoso y bienestar. Se realizó una revisión narrativa crítica de revisiones sistemáticas, metaanálisis, revisiones de alcance y revisiones paraguas, complementada con documentos científicos y de organismos profesionales. La evidencia reciente muestra que el uso general de redes sociales presenta asociaciones pequeñas, débiles o inconsistentes con el bienestar y el malestar psicológico; en contraste, el uso problemático o compulsivo presenta asociaciones más consistentes con depresión, ansiedad, estrés y deterioro del bienestar. También se identifican mecanismos potenciales como comparación social, exposición a contenido dañino, alteración del sueño, búsqueda de validación y experiencias de ciberacoso. Al mismo tiempo, las redes pueden favorecer apoyo social, pertenencia, autoexpresión, acceso a información y programas de promoción de la salud mental. La literatura más reciente resalta que los efectos dependen de características individuales, tipo de interacción, contenido, contexto y diseño de las plataformas. Se concluye que no es científicamente adecuado afirmar que las redes sociales causan por sí mismas problemas de salud mental; la evidencia respalda una relación compleja, bidireccional y heterogénea, especialmente relevante cuando el uso se vuelve problemático.</jats:p>
title: El uso de las redes sociales y su efecto en la salud mental de los jóvenes
subtitle: Revisión de revisiones de la evidencia científica publicada entre 2020 y 2026

items.abstract: <jats:p>This article examines how whiteness operates as an organizing principle of racial, national, and sexual hierarchies in Santiago de Chile’s “cafés polarizados” (tinted coffee shops), and how the racialization of migrant women produces differentiated forms of inclusion, exclusion, and labor precarity within a highly stratified sexual marketplace. Drawing on sociohistorical, decolonial, and intersectional perspectives, the study explores the relationship between the historical construction of the Chilean nation, colonial legacies, and contemporary experiences of migration and sexual labor. The article is based on an ethnography that combined participant observation; interviews with workers, owners, managers, and clients of “cafés polarizados”; online blogs; and qualitative discourse analysis. The findings show that whiteness functions as a norm of desirability and belonging that assigns differential value to bodies. On the one hand, migrant women – particularly AfroCaribbean women – are frequently subjected simultaneously to processes of racialization and sexualization. On the other hand, clients and workers reproduce racial imaginaries that associate certain bodies with danger, hypersexuality, incivility, or poor hygiene, legitimizing everyday forms of exclusion. The article concludes that these dynamics are not isolated expressions of discrimination but rather manifestations of historically rooted power relations that articulate race, gender, nationality, and sexuality in the production of contemporary inequalities.</jats:p>
title: Blanquitud, racismo estructural y trabajo sexual en los “cafés polarizados” de Santiago de Chile
